Hi Samira — thanks for sending these. Quick confirmations and next steps from procurement: 

- We received the onboarding form and the NTN / E-TIN scans. I’ve uploaded them to our vendor intake folder (link below).
- For PO activation we need:
  1) Completed Redwood supplier W-8-equivalent questionnaire we attach below (small form: confirms tax residency and bank details).
  2) Confirmation whether BanglaPrint will invoice Redwood from a Bangladesh legal entity or from an overseas branch (this affects PO entity mapping).

PO timing: once finance validates the NTN and bank details and we get the tax memo or withholding guidance, we can push the vendor to active in our system and issue the first PO. Typical turnaround 3–5 business days after documentation is complete.

Hi all — quick tax note from our side:

- We do not require a Bangladeshi fiscal representative at this stage. Our main concerns are correct invoicing and evidence of NTN/E-TIN so that AP can apply zero-rating or withhold as appropriate.
- If BanglaPrint bills from a Bangladesh-registered entity and invoices are VAT zero-rated for export, AP will code the PO as VAT-exempt and expect a short tax memo (1–2 pages) confirming the export status.
- If Bangladesh withholding applies, we will withhold at the applicable statutory rate and require a withholding receipt/certificate from BanglaPrint post-payment so we can claim the credit in our tax system.

Samira — please send: (1) a reissued invoice with an explicit VAT line or a zero-rate statement, (2) a bank statement matching beneficiary name, and (3) a 1-page memo from your tax advisor on VAT zero-rating and WHT expectations. Once we have those three items AP will finalize vendor activation and Karthik can issue the first PO.

Thanks — I’ll standby for the documents.

Best,
Ben Carter
Tax Manager | Redwood Inference
